name: moirai_integrate
description: Wire the annotated application to moirai - environment (with a symlink shim so the app's own Python imports moirai without installing it into the app venv), compile and link flags, build; checks that moirai_env.sh puts the shim and annotated root on PYTHONPATH and that the generated provenance helper imports under the app's Python. Load for the integrate stage.

history.why: Tool-design fault found at the annotate gate (pipeline elmerfold-prov-20261030-125944): annotate_validate could not pass because it tried to check moirai_env.sh, which this stage writes after annotate. The PYTHONPATH rule belongs here. integrate_validate now checks that moirai_env.sh exists, exports PYTHONPATH naming the annotated root (env_pythonpath), and that `import moirai, _moirai_prov` resolves when that env file is sourced in a clean environment with no inherited PYTHONPATH (env_import); the old python_import check injected PYTHONPATH itself and so never proved the env file works. Adds integrate_env_check so the check is testable without a pipeline. Companion to the prov_annotate proposal that turns helper_on_pythonpath into a deferred note.

Integrate gate weakness (pipeline elmerfold-prov-20261030-125944): env_import ran the moirai venv's own Python, not the app's (/p/lustre5/haridev/elmerfold/openfoldenv/bin/python), and the moirai venv must stay separate from the app venv. moirai_env.sh put the moirai venv bin FIRST on PATH, so bare `python` was the wrong interpreter, and the whole moirai site-packages on PYTHONPATH would shadow the app's typing_extensions/packaging/setuptools. integrate_apply now takes app_python: it builds <provenance>/moirai_shim with symlinks to only the top-level packages in moirai's requirement closure (derived from importlib.metadata, skipping names the app already provides), exports PYTHONPATH=shim:annotated, appends the moirai bin to PATH end and sets MOIRAI_SERVICE, appends to LD_LIBRARY_PATH. integrate_env_check/integrate_validate import under the app Python in a clean env and fail on import error, numpy/scipy/torch pulled in by the helper import, a shadowed app package, or the moirai bin ahead of the app on PATH. Adds plan_shim (pure) and integrate_shim_selftest.
